verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents background automation in its own product: sandbox commands can run on a recurring cron schedule, at a future datetime, or after a delay, with per-run execution history [26]. Jobs can also run scheduled or on-demand batch AI workflows on serverless infrastructure [35][10]. The Blaxel agent skill lets an AI agent set up jobs and deployments by prompt, which fits the AI-native persona [1]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, event-driven (non-time) triggers, and detail on monitoring, alerting, or retry for autonomous runs.
